Optimism Daily Project Summary (Feb 10, 2026)

Today, significant progress was made on unifying the Rust workspace in the `optimism` repository, streamlining development and improving stability, alongside critical bug fixes in alternative data availability and configuration. Across multiple repositories, discussions continued on supporting multiple sequencer RPC endpoints and the blob tip oracle activation, which was reopened for further verification. Documentation was also enhanced with new guides for chain and node operators.

## 🚨 Needs Attention
- **Urgent Discussions**:
    - **ethereum-optimism/infra**: Issue [#763](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/763) on supporting multiple sequencer RPC endpoints needs further input regarding the user experience of configuring multiple URLs versus building redundancy into a single URL.
    - **ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io**: Issue [#763](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/issues/763) on supporting multiple sequencer RPC endpoints requires a decision on whether to prioritize user-friendliness with a single URL or offer optional multi-URL support.
    - **ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops**: Issue [#763](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/763) on supporting multiple sequencer RPC endpoints needs resolution on the trade-off between user-friendliness and reliability, specifically regarding single vs. multiple URL configurations.
    - **ethereum-optimism/docs**: Issue [#763](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/docs/issues/763) on supporting multiple sequencer RPC endpoints requires a decision on the best approach for reliability without compromising user-friendliness.
    - **ethereum-optimism/op-analytics**: Issue [#763](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-analytics/issues/763) on supporting multiple sequencer RPC endpoints needs further discussion to balance user-friendliness with reliability.
    - **ethereum-optimism/optimism**: Issue [#763](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/763) on supporting multiple sequencer RPC endpoints requires a decision on the best approach to achieve high reliability without burdening users with managing multiple URLs.
- **Blocked Issues/PRs**:
    - **ethereum-optimism/infra**: Issue [#18618](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/issues/18618) (Blob Tip Oracle Activation Follow-up) was reopened due to a lingering `TODO` and requires confirmation in production that `newBlobSavings == true` occurs most of the time before activation.
    - **ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io**: Issue [#18618](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/ethereum-optimism.github.io/issues/18618) (Blob Tip Oracle Activation Follow-up) was reopened and is pending confirmation in production that `newBlobSavings == true` occurs most of the time.
    - **ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops**: Issue [#18618](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/18618) (Blob Tip Oracle Activation Follow-up) was reopened and requires confirmation in production that `newBlobSavings == true` most of the time to justify its use.
    - **ethereum-optimism/docs**: Issue [#18618](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/docs/issues/18618) (Follow-up for Blob Tip Oracle Activation) was reopened due to a remaining `TODO` and is pending confirmation in production that `newBlobSavings == true` occurs most of the time.
    - **ethereum-optimism/op-analytics**: Issue [#18618](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-analytics/issues/18618) (Blob Tip Oracle Activation Follow-up) was reopened and requires confirmation in production that the oracle consistently provides benefits.
    - **ethereum-optimism/optimism**: Issue [#18618](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/18618) (Follow-up for Blob Tip Oracle Activation) was reopened due to a remaining `TODO` and requires further monitoring and validation before full activation.

## ✅ Completed Work
### Core Protocol & Infrastructure Enhancements
- **Rust Workspace Unification**: All separate Rust workspaces (`alloy-op-evm`, `alloy-op-hardforks`, `kona`, `op-alloy`, `op-reth`) were unified into a single workspace under `rust/`, simplifying the project structure. ([ethereum-optimism/optimism#19034](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19034))
- **Build System Improvements**: `goreleaser` was updated and integrated with `mise` for more streamlined installations and consistency in the build process. ([ethereum-optimism/infra#550](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/pull/550))
- **Windows Build Compatibility Fix**: A critical bug affecting Windows builds was fixed by implementing OS-dependent `syscall` calls for the `proxyd` component, ensuring cross-platform compatibility. ([ethereum-optimism/infra#549](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/infra/pull/549))
- **Alternative DA & Configuration Fixes**: Issues in the alternative DA manager were addressed, specifically handling cases where no commitments are present when the finalized head is updated. Configuration issues like renaming a deprecated `[alias]` section in `mise.toml` and updating `.semgrepignore` paths were also resolved. ([ethereum-optimism/optimism#18866](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/18866), [ethereum-optimism/optimism#19137](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19137), [ethereum-optimism/optimism#19136](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19136))

### Superchain Operations & Analytics Refinements
- **Sepolia Revenue Sharing Tasks**: New Sepolia tasks for revenue sharing with Ink and Soneium were added, including configuration files and documentation. ([ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops#1369](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/pull/1369))
- **Task Status Updates**: The status of the Unichain U18 task was set to executed, and the Soneium Minato U18 task status was updated. ([ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops#1375](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/pull/1375), [ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops#1373](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/pull/1373))
- **Transaction Qualification Bug Fixes**: Two bug fixes were implemented to improve the qualification of transactions in `op-analytics`, primarily affecting `other_chains_tracking` and `helper_functions` modules for more accurate data processing. ([ethereum-optimism/op-analytics#1792](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-analytics/pull/1792), [ethereum-optimism/op-analytics#1791](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-analytics/pull/1791))

### Documentation & Testing Improvements
- **Enhanced Operator Guides**: New documentation was added to provide chain operators with a comprehensive guide on transaction fees, detailing parameters and adjustment procedures. ([ethereum-optimism/docs#1961](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/docs/pull/1961))
- **Improved Node Operator Resources**: Documentation for node operators was updated to include information on Reth snapshots, providing clearer guidance on network information and management. ([ethereum-optimism/docs#1976](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/docs/pull/1976))
- **Challenger Testing**: New tests were added to `op-acceptance` to ensure the challenger calculates correct transitions when the next super root is unavailable. ([ethereum-optimism/optimism#19112](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19112))
- **CI/CD Tooling Updates**: CircleCI utilities were updated and Semgrep was upgraded to a newer version to fix CI failures. ([ethereum-optimism/optimism#19129](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19129), [ethereum-optimism/optimism#19121](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19121))
